text_block_list.text: The race came to an end—

Curren Chan brilliantly defeated
her formidable rival, Nishino Flower.
Yet, her expression was far from cheerful—
choice_data_list: You gave it your all, Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm happy, okay?
But... Curren wasn't the only one
who was overwhelmingly cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-chan completely captivated the audience too.
I can't be purely happy about this."
choice_data_list: Even though you won fair and square...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's not the point!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's still a long way to go
before I become the cutest Umamusume around...

It was a good race, but Curren Chan
doesn't seem satisfied yet. In that case—
choice_data_list: You just need to shine even brighter in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. Curren's path is still going.
Next time, on an even bigger stage,
I'll captivate everyone even more than today!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, Curren has to run in a GⅠ again!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis, Curren needs to run in another GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...So I lost, huh.

Curren Chan put on a great performance too, but Nishino Flower's strength proved superior.
Just as I wondered if she'd be down about the result—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Fufu, fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren isn't broken, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren isn't broken, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're just easy to read, Big Brother!
Wait, that doesn't matter right now—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're just easy to read, Big Sister!
Wait, that doesn't matter right now—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is in a super great mood right now.
I mean, losing today just means...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It just proves that Curren can become even cuter...
Doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think that's incredible?
Hehe... this is getting interesting!

It was a wonderful smile, yet in her eyes
there seemed to be a flame burning...
If so, then to fuel that competitive fire even further—
choice_data_list: The next race will be a cute revenge match.
The next race will be a cute revenge match.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're right!
Curren's cuteness is just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, Curren has to run in a GⅠ again!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis, Curren needs to run in another GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Goals for the race?
Hmm... None, I guess!
Thinking back to when we first started, I can really feel Curren Chan's motivation for racing getting stronger...
"In that case, as her Trainer, it's up to me to choose the grand stage she desires!"
choice_data_list: Then our next big goal is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!
Then our next big goal is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.text:
Along with the Sprinters Stakes we ran today, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen stands as the other pinnacle of sprint GⅠs.
As a sprinter, it's a race we definitely want to claim.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, can Curren go ahead and tell everyone
that she's aiming for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
choice_data_list: The Ocean Stakes comes first, I think.

text_block_list.text:
I told her that with the Ocean Stakes being known as
a stepping stone to the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
I wanted to win this graded race and build up our momentum.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okay♪
Then let's do something like this...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'#OceanStakes #AimingForIt
#WhichMeans... #NextIs...!
#CheerForMe♪ #CuteCurrenChan'

—The next objective was decided:
the 'Ocean Stakes'!

With our goal decided, we left the racecourse in high spirits.
On the way back, a little incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Um, Onii-chan, look at this...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Um, Onee-chan, look at this...

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chaaan!
Look over hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Don't push, I can't see Curren!
Your camera's the one in the way!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: (Murmurs and chatter...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The cheers are even louder than before the race...
Or rather, is it kind of an uproar?
choice_data_list: Is this also the result of PR activities...?

text_block_list.text:
Just like before, Curren Chan kept the cycle going—
using PR activities to lead into races, and gaining more fans as a result.

Since it was right after the GⅠ 'Sprinters Stakes',
it wouldn't be surprising if that effect
was felt even more strongly, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...If that really were the only reason,
Curren would be super happy, though.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me~.
Miss over there~♪

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, m-me...!?
Whoa, you're way too cute in person! Are you a sculpture!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, in the flesh♪
Curren seems super popular for some reason though~...
Do you know why?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Please give a reason
other than Curren being cute♪

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? M-Maybe on Umatter?
Curren-san was trending, after all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I see. So that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I became a fan today too!
I've already followed all your accounts!
You're so, so cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~♪
Please keep cheering for me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
Kyuuuuun!!
Cute Curren Chan!!

After that, with one cute word from Curren Chan's
own mouth, the crowd peacefully dispersed—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I figured it out, Big Brother.
It looks like Flower-chan is the cause."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, I figured it out.
Looks like Flower-chan was the cause.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Though it's not like she did anything herself... Honestly, it'd be quicker if you just saw it for yourself.

On the screen Curren Chan showed me,
words related to her were sweeping the Umatta trends, and—

"What's her age? Income? Does she have a boyfriend?
We investigated the trending Curren Chan to find out!"

...The screen showed the state of the internet,
where roundup articles of that sort were being churned out in droves.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to competing with the super popular 'Bento Fairy',
Curren's popularity on Umatter seems to have gone up!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Onii-chan. I think Curren can finally see it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Onee-chan. I think Curren can finally see it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How Curren should fight going forward,
and what kind of charm I should show...

"...Just what is Curren Chan
trying to fight against?
Does it have anything to do with racing...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
First, identify the... of Tracen Academy,
and then...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think I can see it now.
A future where I reach the peak of cute...♪

Sensing a new wave of cuteness,
I decided to focus on what I could do to prepare for the Ocean Stakes...
